existing_coverage_reviewed.proof_limit: This proposal inspected cached source scripts and root-recorded proof locations only during the quiet window. Verify immutable snapshot manifests and existing proof identities before building; do not claim a newly rerun focused test.

Record original provenance/source manifests, driver/fixture hashes, toolchain/flags/profile/resolved lock, exact compilation path after release package clean and binary hashes. settings.role: Unchanged compression/edge pipeline; the139-distinct-centroid union exceeds the configured cap, without claiming Stage4 search entry

fixture_rules.validity: Every input run is sorted with distinct means within that run; cross-run ties are intentional. The longest input has100 centroids, below both configured caps. Seed through the public with_centroids_and_stats builder. Empty runs have zero mass/sum and NaN extrema. No malformed or nonfinite values/weights.
fixture_rules.weights: Except the explicit zero-tie pair, cycle [0.125,0.5,1.25,0.1,1e-309] by (element_index+run_index)%5. These are positive finite f64 masses in both centroid precisions; include exact dyadic, nondyadic and subnormal mass without a new numeric algorithm.
fixture_rules.kinds: Use Mixed iff(element_index+run_index)%3==0, Atomic otherwise. Conceptual Mixed support extends0.25 either side of its mean; Atomic support is its exact mean. Set each run's data_min/data_max from those supports, total_weight by its ordered weight sum and data_sum by ordered mean*weight sum. This is valid synthetic centroid-state comparison, not a claim of empirical quantile accuracy.
fixture_rules.ordering: Keep listed run order. Sort each run by mean before seeding, preserving each centroid's intended weight/kind. Empty slots remain present in the operand list; never filter them in the harness.
fixture_rules.canonical_fixture: Write one canonical raw fixture record with exact centroid mean/weight/kind bits, configuration and metadata bits, plus serialized input digests. Compare full bytes across all three processes before comparing output states.

public_routes.owned_static: TDigest::merge_digests on the complete original operand list, including zero/one inputs and empty slots.
public_routes.borrowed_many: First operand is the mutable accumulator, remaining operands are passed unchanged to TDigest::merge_many; zero operands use a newly configured empty accumulator and no others. Verify every borrowed source digest remains byte-identical. Compare each route to the same route in the independent baseline; do not assume empty-route configuration equivalence.
public_routes.borrowed_pair: For the three fixtures with exactly two raw operands, also call public merge on the first with a borrow of the second. Verify the borrowed second operand's bytes remain unchanged.
public_routes.counts: 13 fixtures x2 precisions x2 settings=52 fixture/config cells per binary; three binaries=156 fresh processes. Each process returns owned and borrowed-many states, plus pair state for the three two-operand fixtures. No extra timing process or repeat is proposed.

exact_checks.state: Full wire bytes; every centroid mean/weight/kind bit; count/sum/min/max bits; returned configuration; exact quantile and CDF output bits. Compare candidate output to immutable baseline for each route/config independently.
exact_checks.queries: Quantile q=[0,0.0001,0.001,0.1,0.5,0.9,0.999,0.9999,1], cast through the configured precision exactly as existing v3 audits. CDF probes include both infinities, signed zeros, all input/output centroid means, each finite mean's adjacent representable f64 values, and adjacent output-centroid midpoints. Preserve the exact query bits in output; baseline and candidate must use identical probes.
exact_checks.avoid_circular_queries: Construct the shared query specification from immutable input fixture means and a separately captured baseline output. Reuse those exact queries for every candidate, never choose a candidate-specific probe grid.
exact_checks.failure_policy: Stop on source/fixture/query/state mismatch, preserve all artifacts and report it. No epsilon, automatic retry, patched fixture or production fix under this proposal. A passed shape audit does not establish a speed win.
exact_checks.reproducibility: Use deterministic formula fixtures; record all exact input and output bits so one fresh process per binary/cell is sufficient for this correctness-only addition. No allocator or performance evidence is inferred.

excluded: No new random iterator suite, scale-family Cartesian grid, benchmark input, candidate combination, original upstream modification, or release action. Existing focused tests and v3 evidence remain authoritative and unchanged.
